name: TRAM_ADVISORY_SPEED_{speed}_YELLOW_TALL
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W5-SA113 (advisory tram speed): W5-SA113B 450 x 600 illustrated (A 300 x 400; PNG W5-SA113A.png), R50, 8 / 24 (edge 8 + border 16). Tram symbol 'R7-1-5' 300 wide (75/300/75), 160 high from 40 below the top — the national R7-1-5 symbol; 40 gap; black ring outer dia 320 (y 240-560, 40 from the bottom; 65 margins), 21 wide measured; speed numerals '160 C (insert required speed limit)' centred in the ring ('=' / varies; 60 above the ring's bottom → baseline 480... the dashed box measures y 320-480). The sheet gives no example: generated at 10 to 50 km/h in tens — not confirmed against SA tram practice.
